properties.displayName: AI-LZ: Inherit mandatory tags from the resource group
properties.description: Adds or replaces the specified tag on resources with the value from the parent resource group, so every resource carries Project/BusinessUnit/Environment/CostCenter for cost attribution. Assign once per tag name. Requires a managed identity with Tag Contributor for remediation.
